articles.title: Trump Pauses Project Freedom Hormuz Operation
articles.description: President Trump announced Tuesday evening he was pausing the U.S. effort to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for a deal to end the Iran war, while maintaining the American naval blockade of Iranian ports.

articles.title: U.S. Military Denies Iranian Missile Strike Claims on Warship
articles.description: U.S. Central Command denied Iran's claim that a U.S. warship transiting the Strait of Hormuz was struck by two missiles and forced to retreat during Project Freedom operations.

articles.title: U.S. Forces Fire on Iranian Boats in Hormuz Strait
articles.description: The U.S. military said it fired on Iranian forces and sank six small boats as it moved to reopen the Strait of Hormuz on Monday during Project Freedom operations.

articles.title: Pentagon and Joint Chiefs Brief Trump on Iran Strike Options
articles.description: CENTCOM prepared a plan for a 'short and powerful' wave of strikes on Iran likely including infrastructure targets to break the negotiating deadlock, with Defense Secretary Hegseth and Joint Chiefs Chairman Caine briefing Trump on May 1.

articles.title: CENTCOM Redirects 49 Commercial Vessels Under Blockade
articles.description: CENTCOM reported on May 3 that Admiral Brad Cooper visited U.S. guided-missile destroyers, with 49 commercial vessels redirected to comply with the American naval blockade of Iranian ports since April 13.

articles.title: Iranian Military Warns Against Hormuz Approach
articles.description: Major General Ali Abdollahi warned that any foreign military force, especially the U.S. military, approaching the Strait of Hormuz will be targeted by Iranian forces.

articles.title: Iran Claims Missile Strike on U.S. Frigate
articles.description: Iran's IRGC-aligned Fars News Agency claimed that Iranian navy fired two missiles and hit an American naval frigate in the Strait of Hormuz after it ignored warnings, though CENTCOM denied the strike.

articles.title: Iran Strikes UAE with Cruise Missiles and Drones
articles.description: Iran launched multiple cruise missiles, drones and small boats at UAE targets on May 4, with the emirate's air defenses engaging 19 Iranian missiles and drones, and fires breaking out at oil facilities in Fujairah.

articles.title: Iran Denies Pre-Planned UAE Attacks
articles.description: Iran stated it had 'no pre-planned programme' to attack the UAE, characterizing incidents as products of 'U.S. military adventurism,' while an anonymous military official attributed the oil facility incident to U.S. efforts to create illegal passage.

articles.title: Houthis Halt Attacks Under Ceasefire Agreement
articles.description: On May 6, 2026, the U.S. halted its attacks on the Houthis following a ceasefire agreement where the Houthis would no longer target American shipping after weeks of strikes on over 1,000 targets in Yemen.
